books.label: Book One of the Realmfire Series
books.title: The Burning of the Realm
books.description:
Meet Page, a burned-out millennial healthcare worker who steps out into traffic intending to end it all.

Instead, he wakes up in a fae realm.

Pulled through a portal by Shaylee, an ancient fae living on an isolated island with her giant pet rabbit.

Together, they must navigate their new reality and work together to open another portal to their own realms. Somewhere along the way, Page and Shaylee must confront a question they never expected:

How do you keep living when all you wanted to do was disappear?

The Burning of the Realm is the first novel in the Realmfire Series that blends humor, healing, mythology, and epic fantasy adventure.

books.label: Book Two of the Realmfire Series Coming Early 2027
books.title: The Burned Legacy
books.description:
After stepping into traffic trying to end it all, Page, a burned-out millennial healthcare worker, found himself choosing to stay in the fae realm with Shaylee and her giant, judgmental rabbit named Henry.﻿﻿ Choosing to stay was the easy part, it’s what comes next that is the real challenge.

The realm is in chaos following the events in Rehmani, and the portal problem didn’t go away.

It got bigger.

Portals, old gods, witches, and realm-wide conflicts will all collide, leaving the ultimate question:

What is worth surviving for?
